description: Obtain a FractalAI ML-DSA-65 attestation of a declared payment settlement. The service checks the claimed transfer when a transaction is supplied. Call without payment first for the current price and requirements. Keep the exact request and payment authorization for recovery; this tool never retries payments. Use the witness SDK to construct request_binding for bound requests. An attestation does not prove the purchased content is true.

payment.description: Optional base64 x402 X-PAYMENT (EIP-3009 exact-scheme payload, or {txHash}). x402-aware wallet clients pass this automatically via _meta["x402/payment"] — set it explicitly only if your client does not plumb _meta. Omit on the first call to receive the payment challenge.

request_binding.description: SDK-generated binding; preserve unchanged on recovery.

seal_body.description: Settlement seal body built by the witness SDK.

settlement_tx.description: Known transaction for recovering an uncertain settlement.

name: witness_payment
title: Witness an x402 payment settlement
